prompt:
Bold clean ink linework, flat vibrant cell-shaded colors, rounded expressive character designs, distinctive 1980s Akira Toriyama manga aesthetic. Create ONE finished landscape 1536x1024 comic panel, NOT a character sheet. Beijing present-day ordinary apartment, or 1967 radio station in flashbacks pages 4–6. Cel shading throughout, no watercolor.
SCENE: 풀 스프레드. 청신의 아파트. 석양이 지고 있다. 빈 의자 — 청신이 잠시 자리를 비웠음. 테이블 위 사진(젊은 예원제와 라오충), 찻잔(김이 사라짐). 왕먀오가 창가에 서서 밖을 봄. 커튼이 바람에 흔들림.
Visible named cast: 왕먀오, 예원제, 청신. Character sheets are identity references ONLY; never copy their backgrounds. Wang Miao always wears pale blue-grey shirt and dark trousers. All lettering and exact digits will be added later: NO readable text, numbers, symbols, balloons, captions or watermark in generated artwork. Clean coherent anatomy, strong ink composition, no extra characters or alien creatures. Non-graphic disaster where described.
